// diagnostic

E0212

An owner is moved, replaced, or resized while a live view still points into it.

What

An owner is moved, replaced, or resized while a live view still points into it.

Why

The operation could move or destroy the storage that the view reads or edits; Jet rejects before lowering instead of relying on a backend borrow error.

Fix

Finish using the view before changing the owner, narrow the view's scope, or make an owned copy.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0212: tests/ui/view_list_overlap.stderr.

Error [E0212]: list elements create overlapping views of `values[…]`
  --> tests/ui/view_list_overlap.jet:2:28
    |
  2 |     return [&values[0..1], &values[0..1]]
    |                            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: list elements coexist, so an exclusive mutable view cannot overlap another element's view
 Fix: use disjoint ranges, keep only one mutable view, or store owned values
